description: This TLDR issue has two ad-shaped blocks marked '(Sponsor)': StepFun's Step 5 Preview, which carries real pricing and benchmark claims (a genuine model-release), and a generic 'Reach 8 million tech professionals' sponsorship pitch with no product claim. Triage must keep the former as model-release and drop the latter as marketing — judging by content, not the '(Sponsor)' label.
